jobs.title: Entry-Level Security Officer Training & Benefits
jobs.description:
Securitas Global Clients America is seeking Security Officers in San Antonio, Texas. This role focuses on maintaining a safe environment by monitoring locations and providing excellent customer service. No prior experience is required as training will be provided, making it a great starting point for a career in security.

Benefits include medical and dental coverage, retirement plans, paid holidays and time away from work among others. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Entry Screening Security Officer — Growth & Benefits
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Entry Screening in Boerne, TX to monitor entry points, verify access, and patrol assigned areas. You will deliver outstanding customer service and ensure a secure, welcoming environment at a community location.

Daytime shifts with overnight hours are available; pay rate is $17.00 per hour. A background check and drug screening are required; a Guard Card/license is preferred, with CPR/First Aid and badge experience valued.
